comparison.objective: Push a partly filled bottle to a line without tipping it excessively.
comparison.physical_skill: Nonprehensile pushing with center-of-mass and slosh-aware stability control.
comparison.success_condition: Bottle reaches the line without exceeding 30° tilt; setup and scoring fields are otherwise explicitly missing.
comparison.reason: Stable nonprehensile transport of a liquid container is unrelated to precise impact-tool coordination and post-fracture containment.
